articles.title: France’s vision for the warship of 2040 packs lasers, railguns and drones
articles.summary: French shipbuilder Naval Group has unveiled the SCX 26, a groundbreaking warship concept for the 2040s. This futuristic design features a distinctive double superstructure and incorporates advanced energy weapons and cutting-edge technology. It offers SSB aspirants a glimpse into the evolving naval warfare landscape and the sophisticated capabilities future warships will possess, highlighting significant advancements in maritime defence. This concept underscores the continuous innovation in naval architecture.
